deliverables: 12 months of frontend and backend maintenance and development
public company wallet for monitoring converted stablecoins
periodic independent audits of treasury fund use in February 2027 and August 2027
on-chain metadata records for paid Pro plans and published reports on Pro plan earnings
treasury repayment or donation transactions if stated surplus/income thresholds are met
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund 12 months of Eternl operations, maintenance, support, infrastructure, audits, and continued development while introducing paid Pro plans.

claims.claim: Eternl requests ₳2,350,000, valued at about $0.1787 per Ada, to cover approximately $420,000 of annual operating cost for August 2026 through July 2027.
The proposed budget allocates 55% to frontend, 25% to backend, 5% to support, 13% to admin, and 2% to audits.
Eternl says its work is performed by 10 contributors comprising 6.0 FTE at $70,000 per FTE.
Eternl plans to introduce Pro plans priced at $96 per year for Personal users and $360 per year for Company users.
Eternl claims that about 4.2% of its install base, roughly 5,500 users, buying Pro plans would fully cover its annual $420,000 cost.
Eternl states it has about 100,000 browser-extension installs and about 30,000 installs across Android and iOS.
Eternl states it will convert up to $420,000 worth of Ada into stablecoins in a public company wallet and return any Ada above that amount to the treasury.

Eternl states an independent unaffiliated party will audit treasury fund use in February 2027 and August 2027, covering receipt, custody, conversion, spending, balances, Pro plan income relevant to repayment, and treasury refunds or repayments.
Eternl claims 10-18% of Cardano mainnet transactions are conducted via Eternl.
Eternl states the main UI will not be open-source, though some libraries will be published through its npm organization.

summary: The document requests ₳2,350,000 for 12 months of Eternl operations and development, presents a category budget, describes a paid-plan sustainability path and conditional treasury repayment mechanism, and asserts substantial adoption and governance utility, but many key adoption, feasibility, cost, and oversight claims are stated without external evidence in the anchor text.
